repos_data.description: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for Google Search Console. Query GSC performance data and generate brandable HTML SEO audit reports from Claude, Cursor, Zed, and any MCP client. Read-only, OAuth-based, MIT licensed.
Post-publish SEO performance MCP. Unifies Google Search Console, Matomo, GA4, Clarity, and AI-citation signals per URL and emits a per-URL verdict.
